actor_save_compatibility_migration.reason: A corrected source visibility rule must keep older saved actor lists valid.
actor_save_compatibility_migration.rule: WorldMotionData.normalize drops a KNOWN saved actor whose source spec is now hidden, updates count and returns the dropped ids. Unknown ids, duplicates, out-of-shape entries, added actors and missing still-visible actors keep strict validation. GameSession._validateActors allows only the actor list/count to differ. The dev boundary observation accepts exactly that canonicalization and reports it.
actor_save_compatibility_migration.claim_scope: The game loads and continues the frozen record16 candidate save; the hidden actor never spawns.

silph_elevator_confirm_fix.defect: Source/game/silphStoryController.lua created two EventState:guard callbacks inside one menu:show call. The second guard advanced the serial, so the confirm guard was stale on creation and A silently did nothing in the Silph elevator.
silph_elevator_confirm_fix.fix: One guarded callback owns confirm and cancel, matching the reviewed Hideout elevator shape.
